review_findings.finding: Successful executed acquisitions may write status started_utc, completed_utc and elapsed_ms as null despite source elapsed metadata; approved D-04 requires true measured execution timing. Original receipt observed_utc does not establish a start time.

review_findings.finding: Timed-out PARTIAL/CAPTURE_LIMIT may generate CaptureLimit with threshold policy.max_bytes and unit bytes even though the effective bound was time; same receipt can mark capture_limited for elapsed time. Dimension misattribution violates approved G4-07/D-04.
review_findings.required_action: Capture actual time/byte bound type, threshold, observed extent and omitted minimum truthfully, with separate time/byte cases and independent negative tests.

review_findings.finding: Candidate private/system.json lacks required header and emits unapproved top-level platform_scope and normalization_state. Candidate session_manifest.json omits required manifest_version, minimum_usable, finalized_utc, counts, source_receipts, observation_ids, source_attempt_ids, limit_record_ids, etc. A valid candidate manifest must not be mistaken for exact approved D-02 production conformance.
review_findings.required_action: Implement approved complete exact D-02 required-field/type/nullability/enumeration contract and strict rejection of unknown canonical keys; migrate candidate only on governed branch without modifying raw originals.
